bootstrap.scope: descriptive paired confidence intervals conditional on the fitted transform

config.boundary_rule: No clipping or wraparound. Impossible offsets are misses in the unconditional denominator. Also report offset-available and common-both-neighbors denominators.
limitations: New source observations are not independent reasoning steps by definition.
Whole-proof verdicts are inherited; local context checks are not a new chronological proof certificate.
Primary whitening parameters and statistical settings stay unchanged; transform/threshold calibration reuse is reported as a limitation for P3.
Original queued GPU jobs are retained; no reductions in their time limit.

manual_review.selection: deterministic structural strata; no activation values inspected

config.offset_definition: D = argmax observation index - first rejected observation index; +1 is the following step

positional_null.alternative: excess localization over the position-preserving null
positional_null.multiple_testing: Bonferroni over 3 models x 4 prespecified endpoints for the all-trace whitened comparison only; other subsets are sensitivity diagnostics
positional_null.trace_selection: first lexicographic eligible trace per problem

profile.output: timings only, stored separately from scientific results
profile.selection: within each model and verified/refuted class, nearest saved token length to quantiles 0.1,0.5,0.9,1.0; deduplicate

config.scope: Prospective sensitivity plan for the new segmentation, written after seeing the original experiment; not a new confirmatory preregistration.
config.tie_rule: Earliest maximum, as in the existing primary analysis; report tied maxima separately.

environment.gpu: NVIDIA-SMI has failed because it couldn't communicate with the NVIDIA driver. Make sure that the latest NVIDIA driver is installed and running.
